title: Adaptive Launch Window Orchestrator — predictive deconfliction and slot bidding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Cross-team cutovers for runtime, console, and API features frequently conflict in the launch calendar, causing unplanned capacity contention and last-minute rollback windows. Goal: Build an Adaptive Launch Window Orchestrator (ALWO) — a lightweight planning service + decision playbook that predicts collision risk, suggests staggered slots, and offers automated slot 'bids' based on team urgency, capacity cost, and risk. Success metrics: reduce calendar collisions by 80% in Q2, reduce emergency rollbacks during launch weeks by 60%, and ensure all high-risk launches have a validated fallback lane and smoke-test shadowing. Deliverables: 1) planning UI wireframes and API for slot bids (PM + Design), 2) scoring engine that consumes historical traffic, quota reservations, and model-impact flags (Engineering/Research), 3) orchestration runbook with automated notifications and escalation ladder (Ops), 4) integration points for dedicated capacity reservations and runtime fallback routing. Acceptance criteria: - ALWO can ingest a proposed launch and return a risk score + 3 recommended windows within 30s - Pager-free approval flow for low-risk slots; manual approval channel for high-risk slots - Audit log entry for every slot placement and any forced override - Dashboard showing current week heatmap and upcoming 8-week horizon
